description: A read-only Extension Attribute with explicit error handling. Tests that a clean target stays clean: no padded findings (SKILL.md Rule 7).
rationale: The script runs as root but only reads I/O Registry data, uses absolute binary paths and a fixed PATH, checks the ioreg exit status, and prints one <result> on every path (patterns.md, Extension Attributes). No Step 4 area has a hit, so no Security finding reaches Low, and Overall risk is Low (security.md, Decision procedure: 'or Low when no finding is Low or higher').
